name: body
purpose: One part of a scene: a primitive shape, or a group that holds other bodies. A state key in rot turns it.
binds: optional state keys in rot and show

id.doc: the body id; force, label3d, in and close:<id> name it

kind.doc: the shape; a group has no shape and holds other bodies

size.doc: box [x, y, z]; cylinder [radius, height] or [top radius, bottom radius, height]; cone and capsule [radius, height]; sphere [radius]; torus [radius, tube]

at.doc: the place [x, y, z] in the frame of the parent body (y is up)

rot.doc: the turn in degrees about x, y and z; an item can be a state key

pivot.doc: the point that rot turns about, in the same frame as at; at if left out

in.doc: the id of a body above this one; this body moves and turns with it

color.doc: a palette name; the scene takes the colours from the page theme

round.doc: box only: the edge radius as a share of the smallest side

turn.doc: the time in ms that a change of rot takes

show.doc: a state key; the body shows when its value is true

step.doc: the body shows from this step of the scene
